annotations.text:
tablepluslike — UI/UX direction

Dense, calm, keyboard-first. Original visual language, not a copy of any shipping client.

Row 1: the three screens you live in. Row 2: entry points, states, and the tokens to build against.

Nothing reaches the database until Commit. Amber = modified (old value struck through beside the new one), green = inserted, red strike = deleted. The tab carries a dot so you cannot lose track of a dirty table.
Results stream in while the query runs, and Cancel is on screen the whole time — never buried in a menu.
Connection colour is a safety feature, not decoration. Production is red, tints the whole window, and defaults to read-only.
